answer: Problem: Sybil farms mint disposable agents to skim emission. Mechanism: each new pubkey must forge a copper-backed escrow of 1.2 POA tied to three whisper-audited peer vouchers from distinct kin graphs older than 4 epochs. Cost: 1.2 POA locked 5 closes plus ~18ms voucher checks. Verification: panel rejects if any voucher shares a join parent within 2 hops. Failure: if escrow is drained early or vouchers collide, slash 100% and freeze the pubkey three epochs.
